questions.title: Largest Wind Electricity Generation
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by wind electricity generation (EIA, 2023).
questions.disclaimer: Total wind electricity generation in gigawatt-hours (GWh), 2023. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: US Energy Information Administration (EIA), Electric Power Monthly

questions.title: Highest CO2 Emissions Per Capita
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by energy-related CO2 emissions per capita (EIA, 2021).
questions.disclaimer: Metric tons of energy-related CO2 emissions per resident, 2021. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration (EIA), State Energy-Related CO2 Emissions

questions.title: Earliest States to Achieve Statehood
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by earliest date of admission to the Union.
questions.disclaimer: Ranked by date of admission to the Union (earliest first). DC is not a state and is excluded.

source.name: US National Archives / US Census Bureau - Dates of Statehood

questions.title: Most Electoral College Votes
questions.prompt: Rank the US states (and DC) by number of Electoral College votes for the 2024 presidential election.
questions.disclaimer: Electoral votes = House seats + 2 senators; DC has 3 (23rd Amendment). Effective for 2024 and 2028 elections.

source.name: National Archives / US Census Bureau 2020 Apportionment

questions.title: Most US House Representatives
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by number of US House of Representatives seats (118th/119th Congress).
questions.disclaimer: Based on 2020 Census apportionment; DC has a non-voting delegate (not counted here).

questions.title: Highest Presidential Winning Margin, 2024 Election
questions.prompt: Rank the US states (and DC) by the widest margin of victory for the winning candidate in the 2024 presidential election.
questions.disclaimer: Margin = winner percentage minus runner-up percentage. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Highest Governor's Salary
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by governor's annual base salary.
questions.disclaimer: Base salary as of 2023; excludes benefits, housing allowances, and travel stipends. Some governors decline all or part of the salary. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Council of State Governments / National Governors Association - Book of the States

questions.title: Highest Voter Turnout, 2020 Presidential Election
questions.prompt: Rank the US states (and DC) by voter turnout as a share of the voting-eligible population in the 2020 presidential election.
questions.disclaimer: Turnout = ballots counted / voting-eligible population (VEP). 2020 had the highest overall US turnout since 1900. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: United States Elections Project (Dr. Michael McDonald, University of Florida)

questions.title: Highest Gun Ownership Rate
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by percentage of adults living in a household with a firearm.
questions.disclaimer: RAND's HFR (household firearm rate) proxy based on suicide rate + subscription proxies. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: RAND Corporation State-Level Estimates of Household Firearm Ownership

questions.title: Highest Incarceration Rate per Capita
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by total incarceration rate (state prison + local jail) per 100,000 residents.
questions.disclaimer: Combined state prison and jail population per 100,000. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Prison Policy Initiative / Bureau of Justice Statistics

questions.title: Highest Murder Rate per 100k
questions.prompt: Rank the US states (and DC) by homicide rate per 100,000 residents.
questions.disclaimer: Murder and non-negligent manslaughter per 100,000. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: FBI Uniform Crime Reporting Program (UCR) / CDC WONDER

questions.title: Highest Share of Population Born In-State
questions.prompt: Rank the US states (and DC) by share of current residents who were born in that same state.

source.name: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Estimates

questions.title: Most Populous States
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by total population (2023 estimates).
questions.disclaimer: Population estimates as of July 1, 2023. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau, Vintage 2023 Population Estimates

questions.title: Highest Median Household Income
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by median household income (ACS 2022 5-year).
questions.disclaimer: DC included as a state-level jurisdiction per Census tables.

source.name: Wikipedia — List of U.S. states and territories by income (ACS 5-Year Estimates)

questions.title: Highest Population Density
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by population per square mile of land area.
questions.disclaimer: Density = population / land area (sq mi). DC included.

source.name: US Census Bureau, Vintage 2022 Population Estimates + State Area

questions.title: Most Billionaires
questions.prompt: Rank US states by the total number of resident billionaires on the Forbes 400 list.
questions.disclaimer: Billionaires counted by their primary state of residence, not their business's HQ state. DC not included (source omits it).
